Definition: Naphish, a son of Ishmael, and his posterity
BiblicalUsage: Naphish is a son of Ishmael, named in the list of the twelve princes of his line. In Genesis 25:15 Naphish stands among Hadar and Tema and Jetur and Kedemah, the sons of Ishmael, and in 1 Chronicles 1:31 the same names are listed again as the sons of Ishmael.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sons of Ishmael are remembered because God keeps His promises to the children of the bondwoman too. Naphish is a prince of a line God said He would bless, and the book counts him.
